devdoc.details: A contract with functions to facilitate bridging tokens across different blockchains.

BridgingFeeFromTokens(uint256).details: Emitted when this contract charged the sender with the tokens for the bridging fee.

ReceiveFee(uint256,uint256).details: Emitted when this contract receives the bridging fee.

Received(address,uint256).details: Emitted when the contract receives native tokens (e.g. Ether on the Ethereum network) from the admin to supply the gas for bridging.

Swapped(address,address,bytes32,bytes32,.details: Emitted during the on-chain swap of tokens.

TokensReceived(uint256,bytes32,uint256,u.details: Emitted when the tokens are received on the destination blockchain.

TokensSent(uint256,bytes32,uint256,bytes.details: Emitted when tokens are sent on the source blockchain.

addBridgeToken(uint256,bytes32).details: Adds the address of a token on another chain to the list of supported tokens for the specified chain.

params.chainId_: The chain ID where the token is deployed.
params.tokenAddress: The address of the token to add as a supported token.

addPool(address,bytes32).details: Adds the address of the `Pool` contract to the list of supported liquidity pools.

params.token: The address of the token in the liquidity pool.

getBridgingCostInTokens(uint256,uint8,ad.details: Calculates the amount of bridging fee nominated in a given token, which includes: - the gas cost of making the receive transaction on the destination chain, - the gas cost of sending the message to the destination chain using the specified messenger protocol.

params.destinationChainId: The ID of the destination chain.
params.messenger: The chosen way of delivering the message across chains.
params.tokenAddress: The address of the token contract on the source chain.

returns._0: The total price of bridging, with the precision according to the token's `decimals()` value.

params.chainId: The ID of the chain where to send the message.
params.protocol: The messenger used to send the message.

returns._0: The calculated gas cost of the messaging transaction in the current chain's native token.

params.chainId: The ID of the chain where to send the message.
params.protocol: The messenger used to send the message.

returns._0: The amount of gas a messaging transaction uses.

params.chainId: The ID of the chain for which to get the gas cost.

returns._0: The calculated gas cost of the transaction in the current chain's native token

params.protocol: The messenger used to send the message.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the message has been received.
A boolean indicating whether the message has been sent.

hashMessage(uint256,bytes32,uint256,uint.details: Produces a hash of transfer parameters, which is used as a message to the bridge on the destination chain      to notify that the tokens on the source chain has been sent.

params.amount: The amount of tokens being transferred.
params.destinationChainId: The ID of the destination chain.
params.messenger: The chosen way of delivering the message across chains.
params.receiveToken: The token being received on the destination chain.
params.recipient: The address of the recipient on the destination chain.
params.sourceChainId: The ID of the source chain.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

receiveTokens(uint256,bytes32,uint256,by.details: This function is called only after a bridging has been initiated by a user      through the `swapAndBridge` function on the source chain.

params.amount: The amount of tokens being bridged.
params.messenger: The protocol used to relay the message.
params.nonce: A unique nonce for the bridging transaction.
params.receiveAmountMin: The minimum amount of receiveToken required to be received.
params.receiveToken: The address of the token being received.
params.recipient: The recipient address for the bridged tokens.
params.sourceChainId: The ID of the source chain.

registerBridge(uint256,bytes32).details: Registers the address of a bridge deployed on a different chain.

params.bridgeAddress: The address of the bridge contract to register.
params.chainId_: The chain ID of the bridge to register.

removeBridgeToken(uint256,bytes32).details: Removes the address of a token on another chain from the list of supported tokens for the specified chain.

params.chainId_: The chain ID where the token is deployed.
params.tokenAddress: The address of the token to remove from the list of supported tokens.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAllbridgeMessenger(address).details: Sets the Allbridge Messenger contract address.

params.allbridgeMessenger_: The address of the Messenger contract.

setGasOracle(address).details: Sets the Gas Oracle contract address.

params.gasOracle_: The address of the Gas Oracle contract.

setGasUsage(uint256,uint256).details: Sets the amount of gas used for a transaction on a given chain.

params.gasAmount: The amount of gas used on the chain.

setRebalancer(address).details: Allows the admin to set the address of the rebalancer.

setStopAuthority(address).details: Allows the admin to set the address of the stopAuthority.

setWormholeMessenger(address).details: Sets the Wormhole Messenger contract address.

params.wormholeMessenger_: The address of the WormholeMessenger contract.

startSwap().details: Switches on the possibility to make swaps.

stopSwap().details: Switches off the possibility to make swaps.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to be swapped.
params.receiveAmountMin: The minimum amount of tokens required to receive during the swap.
params.receiveToken: The token to receive in exchange for the swapped token.
params.recipient: The address to receive the tokens.

swapAndBridge(bytes32,uint256,bytes32,ui.details: This function is used to initiate a cross-chain transfer. The specified amount of token is first transferred to the pool on the current chain, and then an event `TokensSent` is emitted to signal that tokens have been sent on the source chain. See the function `receiveTokens`. The bridging fee required for the cross-chain transfer can be paid in two ways: - by sending the required amount of native gas token along with the transaction   (See `getTransactionCost` in the `GasUsage` contract and `getMessageCost` in the `MessengerGateway` contract). - by setting the parameter `feeTokenAmount` with the bridging fee amount in the source tokens   (See the function `getBridgingCostInTokens`).

params.amount: The amount of tokens to be swapped (including `feeTokenAmount`).
params.destinationChainId: The ID of the destination chain.
params.feeTokenAmount: The amount of tokens to be deducted from the transferred amount as a bridging fee.
params.messenger: The chosen way of delivering the message across chains.
params.nonce: An identifier that is used to ensure that each transfer is unique and can only be processed once.
params.receiveToken: The token to receive in exchange for the swapped token.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.token: The address of the token contract.

devdoc.title: Bridge

addBridgeToken(uint256,bytes32).notice: Allows the admin to add a new supported destination token.

addPool(address,bytes32).notice: Allows the admin to add new supported liquidity pools.

getMessageCost(uint256,uint8).notice: Get the gas cost of a messaging transaction on another chain in the current chain's native token.

getMessageGasUsage(uint256,uint8).notice: Get the amount of gas a messaging transaction uses on a given chain.

getTransactionCost(uint256).notice: Get the gas cost of a transaction on another chain in the current chain's native token.

hasReceivedMessage(bytes32,uint8).notice: Checks whether a given message has been received via the specified messenger protocol.

hasSentMessage(bytes32).notice: Checks whether a given message has been sent.

receiveTokens(uint256,bytes32,uint256,by.notice: Completes the bridging process by sending the tokens on the destination chain to the recipient.

registerBridge(uint256,bytes32).notice: Allows the admin to add new supported chain destination.

removeBridgeToken(uint256,bytes32).notice: Allows the admin to remove support for a destination token.

swap(uint256,bytes32,bytes32,address,uin.notice: Swaps a given pair of tokens on the same blockchain.

swapAndBridge(bytes32,uint256,bytes32,ui.notice: Initiates a swap and bridge process of a given token for a token on another blockchain.

withdrawBridgingFeeInTokens(address).notice: Allows the admin to withdraw the bridging fee collected in tokens.

withdrawGasTokens(uint256).notice: Allows the admin to withdraw the bridging fee collected in native tokens.
